audit_scope: explicit source unit columns in the complete pinned BBB, Bioavailability, Skin, and ClinTox raw Parquets
comparison: HEAD units.py versus working-tree units.py; both use the working-tree task qualifier policy so code and vocabulary effects are separated
review_notes: Lowercase msec/millisecond forms are unambiguous time units; mS, Ms, and MS remain unresolved to avoid a conductance or mass-spectrometry collision.
Bullet and dot-operator glyphs are multiplication separators; the existing parser keeps slash-then-dot factors in the denominator unless an endpoint-specific standardizer resolves the quantity.
Large signed powers fail closed before arithmetic, which prevents compound and radiolabel identifiers from becoming physical exponents.
Removing bw/BW from the ClinTox qualifier vocabulary eliminated the only observed cross-task vocabulary effect; reviewed body-weight units are handled by exact ClinTox aliases instead.
The shared atomic percent-rate conversion is exercised by 53 ClinTox Stage-03 rows and by zero BBB, Bioavailability, or Skin Stage-03 rows.
